text.KredimGeldi hakkında merak ettiğiniz her: In this section you can find everything you want to know about KredimGeldi. We answer frequently asked questions about loan applications, payment processes, the credit report and our other services.
text.1. KredimGeldi Kredi Karnesi Nedir?: 1. What Is the KredimGeldi Credit Report?
text.KredimGeldi Kredi Karnesi, geçmişteki kr: The KredimGeldi Credit Report is a report that assesses your credit history by analyzing your past loan and credit card payment behavior, your financial habits and the information you provide. It identifies potential risks you may face in loan applications and offers personalized recommendations to help you improve your credit score.
text.2. İhtiyaç Kredisi Başvurusu Yaparken Ne: 2. What Should I Watch Out for When Applying for a Personal Loan?
text.İhtiyaç kredisi başvurusu yapmadan önce,: Before applying for a personal loan, be sure to compare offers from different banks and choose the most suitable loan. Review the payment plans and term options to determine an installment amount you can comfortably repay. Also, make sure to find out whether there are any insurance or other additional fees.
text.3. Ne Kadar Taşıt Kredisi Kullanabilirim: 3. How Much Vehicle Loan Can I Get?
text.Taşıt kredisi tutarı, ilgili yönetmelikl: The vehicle loan amount varies with the value of the vehicle, in line with the applicable regulations. For new vehicles, you can borrow up to a certain percentage of the final invoice price; for used vehicles, up to a certain percentage of the comprehensive car insurance (kasko) value. For vehicles priced at 400,000 TL or less, the loan amount cannot exceed 70% of the vehicle's value, while the limit is 50% for vehicles between 400,001 TL and 800,000 TL, 30% for vehicles between 800,001 TL and 1,200,000 TL, and 20% for vehicles between 1,200,001 TL and 2,000,000 TL. For example, for a vehicle worth 500,000 TL, you can get a vehicle loan of at most 250,000 TL. For this reason, vehicle loan calculations should be based on the vehicle's final invoice price or kasko value.
text.4. Herkes Konut Kredisi Alabilir Mi?: 4. Can Anyone Get a Home Loan?
text.Konut kredisi, genellikle yüksek tutarla: A home loan is a financing instrument that is generally provided in large amounts and over long terms. For this reason, banks carefully review applicants' age, income level and credit history. After this assessment, the bank's credit allocation unit decides whether to approve the home loan application.
text.5. Teklifleri görmek için üye olmam gere: 5. Do I need to sign up to see offers?
text.Hayır. Kredi tutarını ve vadeyi seçtiğin: No. Once you choose the loan amount and term, you can see banks' offers without signing up. Membership is for saving your details and tracking your applications.
text.Başvurunuz önce alınır ve ilgili bankanı: Your application is first received and then forwarded to the relevant bank for assessment. If you applied as a member, you can track every step under My Account > My Applications and, once it is finalized, see the approved amount and installment.
text.Bilgileriniz şifreli bağlantıyla iletili: Your information is transmitted over an encrypted connection and used only to assess your application. For details, see our Personal Data Protection and Privacy Notice pages.
